values.CP2K_PARTITION: Slurm partition the benchmark job runs in
values.CP2K_CORES_PER_NODE: cores per node; a full-node layout R x T has R * T equal to this
values.CP2K_SCAN_LAYOUTS: space-separated full-node R x T layouts the scan stage times
values.CP2K_PYTHON: front-end Python (3.8+, with numpy) that runs the helper scripts
values.CP2K_SRUN_MPI: srun flag selecting the MPI plugin the CP2K build needs, e.g. --mpi=pmix
values.CP2K_SMOKE_LAYOUTS: two full-node layouts the smoke stage runs (default SMOKE_LAYOUTS)
values.CP2K_BUILD_CORES: cores of the one-node build job
values.CP2K_BUILD_JOBS: make -j for the build, low enough that compiles fit in the job's memory
values.CP2K_BUILD_WALLTIME: walltime of the build job, HH:MM:SS
values.CP2K_LAUNCH: launch_plan's job-spec templates: {pre_launch, launcher, environment}, with {R} ranks/node, {T} threads/rank, {N} nodes, {env_script} and other values by name
values.CP2K_BENCH_LAUNCH: the benchmark scripts' launcher for one CP2K step (run_layouts.sh), with {R} ranks in all, {T} threads per rank, {N} nodes, {RPN} ranks per node and {NODEOPT} (srun's --nodes/--ntasks-per-node on a multi-node step, else empty), e.g. srun --mpi=pmix --ntasks={R} --cpus-per-task={T} {NODEOPT} ... or mpirun --map-by ppr:{RPN}:node:PE={T}; no single quote
